display_long_description:
Welcome to the early demo of Cibus Survival, an adrenaline-pumping VR Survivors-like with thrilling roguelite mechanics!🎮 Survive the endless swarm, score high, and beat your own record in this intense roguelike challenge!

📖 Survival Guide

1. Move & Dash: Swing your arms to move. Need to escape a tight spot? Press both Triggers simultaneously to dash! Monsters constantly walk toward you, and touching them drains your HP.💨

2. Get Stronger: Defeated monsters drop XP gems and Gold. Level up your weapons and scrolls to build powerful roguelike loadouts and become unstoppable!⚔️

3. Field Objects: Explore the map and build the ultimate loadout!

Jars: Approach Jars to secure extra XP and Gold.🍯

Chests: Spend your Gold to open Chests for powerful items.🎁

Shrines: Stand inside a glowing Shrine for 5 seconds to permanently boost a core stat.🏛️

4. Altars & Yetti: Stand on the 4 Altars for 5 seconds each to activate them. Once activated, the giant boss Yetti descends! Dodge its attacks and eliminate the threat.👿

5. Final Stand: Warning! Survive past 7 minutes, and the true challenge begins. The difficulty skyrockets as massive hordes of stronger monsters flood the map. Fight until your last breath, record your final score, and try again!🏆

Jump in, swing your arms, and see how long you can survive the swarm!✨
